detail.body:
## Background

Nightly Megatron-Core bump for the `main` lane: MCore `8442db19` → `db3a6cd8a03eb550e9fa4532a0db96778bb56fc5` (9 commits). `.dev.commit` is unchanged.

## What changed

- `.main.commit` and the `3rdparty/Megatron-LM` gitlink now point to `db3a6cd8`.
- `uv.lock` was regenerated with `uv lock --upgrade` (uv pinned by `docker/Dockerfile.ci`). `pyproject.toml` is unchanged; the TE, flash-mla and fast-hadamard-transform dependency metadata already matches MCore at `db3a6cd8`.
- Two Qwen3.5 long-context recipe unit tests now call `mixed_precision.finalize()`/`setup()` before `validate()`, the same order `runtime_config_update` uses. MCore 65ac8216e (#7606) rejects GLU interleave with fp32 params, so the fp8 variants failed when they were validated before mixed-precision setup.

## Details

Lock changes vs `main`: openai 3.35.1, paramiko 5.1.0, platformdirs 4.13.4, virtualenv 21.14.10.

## Tested

Ran on H100 in a validation image built from the bump head `cca79933` (same MCore pin and lock as this branch). The source tested is this exact tree.
- Unit: 4/4 rows passed (Core shards 0–2 and Diffusion). Before the test fix, Core shard 1 failed 2 fp8 GLU-interleave cases.
- Functional: 74/75 rows passed. `L1_Launch_recipes_glm_vl` was skipped because the GLM-4.5V HF config is not available offline; main CI skips the same tests for the same reason (run 39103294373).
- `L1_Launch_gtp_checkpoint_conversion` skips its MXFP8 case because it needs Blackwell, as on main CI.

CI on this PR is pending.

Could a maintainer please use **Re-run failed jobs** on [CICD NeMo run 39121745769](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/39121745769)? It's at head `88e2fc6e`.

Attempt 2 was cancelled by CI infrastructure, not by a test failure:
- `gb200_L0_Launch_models_muse_spark_open` (job 117674191180) and `gb200_L2_Launch_models_olmoe` (job 117674191197) both stopped with `The runner has received a shutdown signal` (exit 130) about 2 minutes after starting.
- The other 134 jobs passed. That includes `Launch_Unit_Tests_Core_1`, whose attempt-1 failure in `test_safe_config_loader` was a flaky test: it patches `time.sleep` for the whole process, so it also counts sleep calls from other threads.
- `Nemo_CICD_Test` failed only because of the two cancelled jobs.

All other workflows on this head have passed, including Build/validate/release and the Installation Test.

Thanks for the re-run. [CICD NeMo run 39121745769](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/39121745769) attempt 3 ended as cancelled, but again only because of CI infrastructure:
- `gb200_L0_Launch_models_muse_spark_open` passed on the re-run.
- `gb200_L2_Launch_models_olmoe` (job 117742057644) was not re-run. It still shows the cancelled result from attempt 2. Its log shows `L2_Launch_models_olmoe — PASSED` before `The operation was canceled` in the check step, when the runner shut down.
- `Nemo_CICD_Test` (job 117743020489) failed only because a GitHub API call returned `HTTP 502: Server Error` while it was listing the run's jobs.

The other 135 jobs passed. Could a maintainer please use **Re-run failed jobs** once more, so that the GB200 olmoe job and `Nemo_CICD_Test` both run again? No code change is needed on head `88e2fc6e`.
